ko: UNESCO 권고: 표지 빼고 49쪽 이상을 책으로 세고 재쇄는 종수에 넣지 않음
en: UNESCO recommendation: a book has 49+ pages excluding covers; reprints are not counted as titles
source_quote: "a non-periodical printed publication of at least 49 pages, exclusive of the cover pages" (para. 6); reprints counted in copies only (para. 8)
source_location: UNESCO, Recommendation concerning the International Standardization of Statistics Relating to Book Production and Periodicals, 19 Nov 1964

ko: VD16→VD17: 편목 규칙이 바뀜(VD16·17은 알려진 사본을 모두 살펴 이본을 반영)
en: VD16 to VD17: cataloging rules change (VD16/17 examine all known copies, taking print variants into account)
source_quote: "While VD16 and VD17 aim at recording all known copies of an edition, in VD18 only one copy per edition is included." / three cataloging systems (VD16 guidelines, RAK, RDA)

en: VD17 to VD18: one copy per edition recorded

source_quote: "1880-1919, includes pamphlets; 1920-1928, pamphlets included in total only; thereafter, pamphlets excluded entirely."

en: 1959: UNESCO definition of a book adopted
source_quote: "Beginning 1959, data not strictly comparable with previous years because of change in definition of 'book.'"

en: 1967: counted by title rather than by volume
source_quote: "Beginning 1967, books are counted by title rather than by volume."

ko: 2024: 평균 발행 부수 집계 기준 변경
en: 2024: method for average print run changed
source_quote: "평균 발행 부수의 경우 본 보고서부터 집계 기준을 변경하였으며, 변경된 기준은 2024년 데이터부터 적용되었다."

ko: 출판연감(목록 기반)과 출판지표연보(도매 출하 신간)가 겹치는 해: 78113 대 75039
en: Overlap year of Shuppan Nenkan (catalog-based) and Shuppan Shihyo Nenpo (new titles shipped through distributors): 78,113 vs 75,039
source_quote: yearbook ed. 68 source 出版年鑑; ed. 69- source 出版指標年報 (definition: "新刊として、委託または買切条件で出荷されたと推定される部数。重版は除く。")
source_location: Japan Statistical Yearbook table 26-8, editions 68 and 69-72
